definitions.explanation: The soft, fleshy lower part of the outer ear. A large earlobe is traditionally thought lucky, a sign of wealth (as on statues of the Buddha). Also written {耳朶|みみたぶ}.

examples.japanese: {耳|みみ}たぶ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{触|さわ}る→触る：00808_sawaru⟧。
⟦{寒|さむ}さ→寒さ：12336_samusa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{耳|みみ}たぶ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{赤|あか}く→赤い：00585_akai⟧⟦なった→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: My earlobes turned red in the cold.

examples.japanese: ⟦{生地|きじ}→生地：02631_kiji⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{耳|みみ}たぶくらい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{柔|やわ}らかさ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦まで→まで：00490_made⟧こねて⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Knead the dough until it is about as soft as an earlobe.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {耳|みみ}たぶ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ピアス→ピアス：04685_piasu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{開|あ}ける→開ける：00563_akeru⟧: to get one's earlobe pierced
- {耳|みみ}たぶ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{厚|あつ}い→厚い：00690_atsui⟧ / ⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧: to have thick / large earlobes (said to be a lucky sign, {福耳|ふくみみ})
- {耳|みみ}たぶくらい⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{固|かた}さ: about as firm as an earlobe (the standard recipe test for dumpling or noodle dough)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Touching your earlobe after picking up something hot is a common reflex in Japan: earlobes stay cool, so people pinch them to soothe their fingertips.
